title: Get comfortable with AI
label: Start here
takeaway: Build understanding before adding another tool.
practice: Which part of your work feels hardest to start? Choose one task you can describe in a sentence.

title: Find the right information first
label: The foundations
takeaway: A model cannot use information it cannot find.
practice: Choose one task. List the files it needs and where each one lives.

title: Give AI a job and a reason
label: Better instructions
takeaway: Say what you want to make and why it matters.
practice: Write one instruction with three parts: the information to use, the result you need, and who it is for.

title: Turn repeated prompts into a workflow
label: A better way to work
takeaway: A sequence you repeat can become a repeatable process.
practice: Write down three prompts you use together. What result should each step pass to the next?

title: Check what AI thinks matters
label: Use your judgment
takeaway: Review the categories before asking AI to generate.
practice: Look at a set of AI suggestions. Pick one to keep and one to remove. Explain why.

title: Learn by building, together
label: Learning in public
takeaway: Nicole shares the purpose of the workshop: helping women build with AI.
practice: Choose a small project you can build with someone else. What would you like to learn by making it?
